proposed_capability: Route each assisted gameplay effect to its canonical mechanic owner and existing tests in the shared journal, with an independent per-effect fallback reason and reviewable unresolved ownership.
player_save_control_impact: Uses the existing opt-in journal and admission queue. No additional effects, player permissions or save access.
expected_outcome: Effects from distinct microsystems in one listener retain independently attributed before/dispatch/after evidence. Use canonical source owners where registered and preserve unassigned and historical evidence for review.
negative_tests: Legacy events remain readable without inferred identity
Unknown mechanics must never be assigned a guessed owner
Interrupted or unknown actions remain open
Receipt paths cannot close repository or native proof
rollback_path: Revert feature source. Existing v1 journal contents and player saves remain intact.
unresolved_unknowns: Windows Sims runtime is not reachable from the cloud workspace. Exact-build native action proof is separate from this shared evidence harness.
